[FLTRP-EN-7A-2022CUR:P61:B7] 2  John sees Robert’s sad face and wants to help. One day, he finds a way. He puts Robert in a trailer and pulls it along with his bike. For the first time, Robert feels like the other kids. A big, bright smile appears on his face.
